source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current doAdoptItem sets callbackRan when its injected callback starts. If the provider also rejects after invoking that callback, the catch path returns instead of invoking it again. This guard is a later accepted refinement to the 2024 adapter. The inspected doModifyItem path does not contain the same guard, so do not describe duplicate completion protection as universal across both methods.
title: Keep the current adopt rejection guard scoped to its actual adapter
